register.labelZh: SWEAT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: sweat something off 可以表示透過運動流汗減掉額外體重或消耗熱量。；sweat something out 可以描述某人休息並等待發燒、感冒或不適慢慢過去。；sweat over something 可以表示某人花了很多時間思考、處理或擔心某件事。；這些表達可以談論運動效果、身體不適和心力,而不只是表示身體感到炎熱。
register.summaryEn: Sweat something off lets you describe using exercise to lose extra weight or burn extra calories. Sweat something out is used when someone rests and waits for a fever, cold or uncomfortable feeling to pass. Sweat over something shows that a person has spent a lot of time thinking, working or worrying about something. These expressions show that sweat can describe exercise results, illness and mental effort—not only feeling hot.
